flightAttendant.title: Flight Attendant (Cabin Crew)
flightAttendant.shortDesc: Reach for the sky with our elite cabin crew training.
flightAttendant.fullDesc:
Embark on an exciting international career with our Cabin Crew training. This intensive program is the benchmark for anyone wishing to excel in the world of aviation. We go far beyond simple technical skills; we train you to become a true ambassador for the airline you will represent. The curriculum comprehensively covers all aspects of the job: safety and security procedures, emergency situation management, in-flight first aid, and firefighting. You will master these vital skills through practical sessions in our ultra-realistic cabin simulators, which faithfully replicate the conditions of a commercial flight.

At the same time, a major focus is placed on customer service excellence. You will learn to anticipate and respond to the needs of a demanding, international clientele, to manage conflicts with diplomacy, and to provide a memorable travel experience. The training includes modules on intercultural communication, luxury standards, and professional presentation. Our instructors, all former aviation professionals, share their field experience to concretely prepare you for the challenges and joys of this unique profession. Upon completion of your journey, you will be ready to pass the selections of the largest national and international airlines.
flightAttendant.target: Aspiring cabin crew members with excellent communication skills, a service-oriented mindset, and high adaptability.
flightAttendant.prerequisites: Must be at least 16 years old.
flightAttendant.outcomes: Flight Attendant / Cabin Crew for national and international airlines.

luxuryRestaurant.title: Luxury Restaurant Service Staff
luxuryRestaurant.shortDesc: Master the art of fine dining service.
luxuryRestaurant.fullDesc:
Immerse yourself in the heart of the French art of living and become a key player in high gastronomy. Our training dedicated to luxury restaurant service professions is designed for enthusiasts who aim for excellence. This program goes far beyond simple technique; it introduces you to a philosophy of service where every detail matters. You will learn to orchestrate an unforgettable customer experience, from personalized welcome to farewell. The curriculum thoroughly covers the most refined service techniques: French service, English service, tableside flambéing, and carving.

A significant part of the training is devoted to introductory sommelier skills, enabling you to advise clients on food and wine pairings with confidence. You will study major grape varieties, terroirs, and the principles of tasting. The art of table setting will also be central to your learning, with workshops on table dressing and floral decoration. Moreover, we place special emphasis on interpersonal skills: customer psychology, complaint management, loyalty building, and verbal and non-verbal communication. You will graduate from this training with the elegance, rigor, and confidence needed to join the brigades of the world's greatest Michelin-starred restaurants and palaces.
luxuryRestaurant.target: Enthusiasts of gastronomy and service, wishing to work in prestigious establishments.
luxuryRestaurant.prerequisites: Must be at least 16 years old.
luxuryRestaurant.outcomes: Maître d'hôtel, Head Waiter, Junior Sommelier in gastronomic restaurants, luxury hotels.

luxuryHotel.title: Luxury Hotel Service Staff
luxuryHotel.shortDesc: Excel in the world of high-end hospitality.
luxuryHotel.fullDesc:
Enter the exclusive world of luxury hospitality and become one of its artisans. This comprehensive training prepares you to excel in all the reception and service professions that build the reputation of palaces and 5-star hotels. Our approach is immersive and practical, plunging you into the highest standards of excellence. The program is structured around key departments: Front Desk (check-in/check-out, reservation management, billing), Concierge (satisfying the most complex requests, managing a contact book, organizing bespoke services), and Guest Services (housekeeping and luxury room service).

You will learn to master the most widely used Property Management Systems (PMS) in the industry. An entire module is dedicated to the 'Guest Experience,' where you will develop the art of anticipating guest needs, personalizing every interaction, and turning a stay into a memorable experience. Managing delicate situations, intercultural communication, and a perfect command of luxury codes are fundamental skills you will acquire. Our partnerships with prestigious establishments will give you the opportunity to apply your knowledge during internships, ensuring a smooth transition to a promising career.
luxuryHotel.target: Candidates with excellent interpersonal skills, a polished appearance, and a passion for luxury hospitality.
luxuryHotel.prerequisites: Must be at least 16 years old.
luxuryHotel.outcomes: Receptionist, Concierge, Housekeeper in 5-star hotels and palaces.

sommelier.title: Sommelier
sommelier.shortDesc: Become an expert in the world of wine.
sommelier.fullDesc:
Transform your passion for wine into globally recognized expertise. Our Sommelier training is a sensory and technical journey into the heart of the wine world. Designed for future professionals as well as enlightened amateurs, it offers a deep and comprehensive understanding of wine. The program begins with the fundamentals of oenology: viticulture, and the winemaking processes for red, white, rosé, sparkling, and dessert wines. You will explore the great grape varieties and emblematic terroirs of France and the world, understanding the influence of climate and soil on a wine's character.

The core of the training lies in the intensive practice of analytical and geo-sensory tasting. You will learn to identify aromas, evaluate balance, and describe a wine with precise, professional vocabulary. A crucial part of the curriculum is dedicated to cellar management: wine selection, purchasing policy, stock control, and creating an attractive and profitable wine list. Finally, you will master the art of wine service and food and wine pairing, working closely with chefs to create perfect harmonies. Visits to estates and meetings with winemakers complete this immersive training.
sommelier.target: Wine lovers wishing to professionalize their passion, restaurant professionals.
sommelier.prerequisites: Must be at least 16 years old.
sommelier.outcomes: Restaurant Sommelier, Wine Merchant, Wine Advisor, Representative for a winery.

fashionModel.title: Fashion Model
fashionModel.shortDesc: Walk the world's most prestigious runways.
fashionModel.fullDesc:
Unleash your potential and prepare to conquer international runways with our model training program. This intensive course is designed to equip you with all the technical skills and confidence needed to succeed in the highly competitive fashion industry. We train you to master the art of the runway walk, working on your posture, rhythm, and ability to embody the creations you wear. You will participate in numerous practical workshops to perfect your walk, whether for ready-to-wear or haute couture.

In parallel, you will develop ease in front of the camera through photographic posing classes. You will learn to understand light, express emotions, and collaborate with photographers to create impactful images. Building a professional portfolio is a key step, and we will guide you in selecting the best shots. The program also addresses the business aspects of the profession: how to succeed in castings, manage your social media image, understand contracts, and work with an agency. Finally, a component is dedicated to well-being, with advice on nutrition and fitness to maintain the energy and vitality essential for this demanding career.
fashionModel.target: Young talents (men and women) with strong physical potential and a charismatic personality.
fashionModel.prerequisites: Must be at least 16 years old.
fashionModel.outcomes: Runway model, advertising campaigns, fashion editorials.

fle.title: FLE (French as a Foreign Language)
fle.shortDesc: Immerse yourself in the French language and culture.
fle.fullDesc:
Immerse yourself in the richness of the French language and culture with our immersive FLE program. Designed for students from all over the world, our teaching method is dynamic and resolutely focused on communication. We believe the best way to learn a language is to practice it actively. That's why our courses emphasize real-life situations, role-playing, and discussions. You won't just learn French; you'll learn to live in French. Our programs cover all levels of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR), from complete beginner (A1) to proficient (C2).

Each level is structured to develop the four key skills: listening, speaking, reading, and writing. Our qualified and passionate teachers integrate elements of contemporary French culture into every lesson: current events, cinema, music, gastronomy, and much more. We also organize cultural activities, outings, and thematic workshops to enrich your experience and accelerate your learning outside the classroom. Whether your goal is to pursue higher education in France, enter the job market, or simply for the pleasure of speaking the language of Molière, our program will give you the tools and confidence to achieve it.
fle.target: International students, expatriates, professionals, and anyone wishing to learn French.
fle.prerequisites: Must be at least 16 years old.
fle.outcomes: Mastery of French for personal, academic, or professional goals. Preparation for DELF/DALF exams.

hsk.title: HSK - Chinese Proficiency Test
hsk.fullDesc:
Gain official recognition of your Mandarin skills with our intensive HSK (Hanyu Shuiping Kaoshi) preparation program. Whether you're aiming for a scholarship in China, an international career opportunity, or simply validation of your level, this training is the key to your success. We offer targeted preparation for all levels of the exam, from HSK 1 to HSK 6. Our approach is structured and meticulous. For each level, we break down the exam requirements and focus on the systematic acquisition of the required vocabulary and grammar points.

Our courses are designed to intensively strengthen the four tested skills: listening comprehension, reading comprehension, and (for higher levels) written expression. You will practice with typical exercises, regular mock exams, and simulations under real conditions to familiarize yourself with the format and pressure of the test. Our native teachers, who are HSK experts, will provide you with effective strategies to tackle each part of the exam, optimize your time, and avoid common pitfalls. Join us to turn your hard work into an internationally recognized certification.
hsk.target: Students of Chinese, professionals working with China, anyone wishing for official certification of their level.
hsk.prerequisites: Must be at least 16 years old.
hsk.outcomes: Success in the HSK exam, international recognition of Chinese language level.

tefl.title: TEFL - Teach English Abroad
tefl.shortDesc: Get certified to teach English anywhere in the world.
tefl.fullDesc:
Open the doors to the world and launch your international teaching career with our TEFL (Teaching English as a Foreign Language) certification. This intensive and accredited program is your passport to teach English anywhere in the world, from Tokyo to Madrid. It is specially designed to provide you not only with theory but, more importantly, with the practical skills needed to step into a classroom with confidence from day one. The curriculum covers the fundamentals of language pedagogy: how to plan an engaging lesson, how to teach grammar intuitively, how to develop your students' speaking skills, and how to manage a multicultural classroom.

You will participate in interactive workshops and, most importantly, you will have the opportunity to practice your new skills during observed teaching sessions with real learners. Our experienced trainers will provide you with constructive and personalized feedback to help you develop your own teaching style. The training also includes modules on finding a job abroad, cultural adaptation, and creating teaching materials. Upon completion of this program, you will obtain a globally recognized certification, opening up a vast network of professional opportunities on all continents.
tefl.target: Native or bilingual English speakers wishing to travel and teach.
tefl.prerequisites: Must be at least 16 years old.
tefl.outcomes: Globally recognized TEFL certification, access to our network of partner schools for job offers.

businessChina.title: Business & Digital Edge in China
businessChina.shortDesc: Understand and conquer the Chinese market.
businessChina.fullDesc:
Master the codes and unlock the potential of the world's most dynamic market. Our 'Business & Digital Edge in China' program is essential training for entrepreneurs, executives, and marketing professionals who want to succeed in China. Going beyond clichés, this training gives you practical tools and insights to navigate a complex and constantly evolving business environment. The first module is dedicated to intercultural intelligence: understand the concepts of 'Guanxi' (network), 'Mianzi' (face), and negotiation protocols specific to China.

The second module is a deep dive into China's unique digital ecosystem. You will study in detail how WeChat functions as a super-app (messaging, payment, mini-programs), commerce strategies on Tmall and JD.com, and the importance of social networks like Weibo and Douyin for influencer marketing. You will learn to build a tailored digital marketing strategy. The program also addresses the practical aspects of expansion: the different types of legal structures for a foreign company, the logistics of cross-border e-commerce, intellectual property protection, and digital payment systems. You will leave with a clear roadmap for your project in China.
businessChina.target: Business leaders, marketing directors, export managers, entrepreneurs.
businessChina.prerequisites: Must be at least 16 years old.
businessChina.outcomes: Ability to develop and implement a development strategy for the Chinese market.

gatewayEurope.title: Gateway to Europe & Southeast Asia
gatewayEurope.fullDesc:
Conquer new markets with confidence through our 'Gateway to Europe & Southeast Asia' program. This strategic training is specially designed for entrepreneurs and companies, primarily from Asia, who aim to establish themselves and thrive in European markets, while also understanding the dynamics of Southeast Asia. The program is a true gateway that will help you decipher the regulatory, cultural, and commercial complexities of these regions. You will study the legal framework of the European Union, including GDPR, product compliance standards (CE marking), and tax aspects related to international trade.

A significant component is devoted to marketing strategies and product adaptation. You will learn to analyze differences in consumer behavior between European countries and adjust your message and offer for each target market. We will also address logistical challenges: how to optimize your supply chain, choose your distribution partners, and manage import-export. Through concrete case studies and presentations by international trade experts, you will develop a solid action plan for your expansion. This training will give you a decisive competitive advantage to turn your global vision into commercial success.
gatewayEurope.target: Entrepreneurs and managers from Asia wishing to expand into Europe.
gatewayEurope.prerequisites: Must be at least 16 years old.
gatewayEurope.outcomes: Business plan for European expansion, network of contacts in Europe.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.subtitle: Your privacy is important to us.
privacyPolicy.content:
## 1. Introduction ##
This Privacy Policy explains how PERPECTIVE PRO FORMATION collects, uses, and protects your personal information. This policy is applicable to users in the European Union (under GDPR) and in China (under PIPL).

## 2. Information We Collect ##
We collect information that you provide to us directly, such as when you fill out our contact form. This may include your name, email address, phone number, and any other information you provide. We also collect data automatically through your use of our site, such as your IP address and browsing behavior, through cookies and similar technologies.

## 3. Use of Information ##
Your information is used to provide and improve our services, to respond to your inquiries, to send you information about our courses, and for administrative purposes. We process this data based on your consent or our legitimate interest in operating our website.

## 4. Your Rights ##
Under GDPR and PIPL, you have rights over your personal data. These include the right to access, rectify, or erase your data, the right to restrict or object to processing, and the right to data portability. To exercise these rights, please contact us at the address below.

## 5. Data Transfers ##
As an international organization, your data may be transferred and processed in countries outside of your own, including France and China. We take all necessary measures to ensure that these transfers comply with applicable laws and that your data remains protected.

## 6. Data Security ##
We are committed to protecting the security of your personal information. We use a variety of security technologies and procedures to help protect your personal information from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure.

## 7. Contact Us ##
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us via our contact form.
